text: According to a port authority briefing circulated Tuesday and a procurement memo obtained by The Continental Record, the first Isolde-class ferry is rated to carry 650 passengers and 82 vehicles on the Dunmere–Pell strand service. The figure appears in the vessel specification signed by Acting Maritime Commissioner Selwyn Quill and dated Oct. 14. The document says the ferry, built by Halcyon Slipworks, will also accommodate 24 crew members and includes two accessible lounges, a medical bay and a storm-rated loading ramp. Ministry officials said the ship is due to enter trial runs next month, with public service expected before the winter timetable takes effect.
